title: bupleurum tenue
intro: Bupleurum tenue, commonly known as the narrow-leaved hare's ear or narrow-leaved bupleurum, is a flowering plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to promote liver and gallbladder function, and is valued for its health benefits such as reducing fever, relieving headaches, and alleviating symptoms of viral infections. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum tenue include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Bupleurum tenue include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
